springBoot.checkTestConstructors.title: Warn when a Spring test class has a constructor with parameters that Spring will not autowire

springBoot.checkEventListeners.title: Check the parameters and return type of @EventListener methods

springBoot.checkEarlyEvents.title: Warn about @EventListener methods for events published before the context exists

springBoot.checkPropertyValues.title: Warn when a configuration value cannot convert to its key's type (number, boolean, duration, data size, enum, project class, list items)

springBoot.checkMetadataFiles.title: Check (additional-)spring-configuration-metadata.json files (shape, defaults, deprecation, hints, project classes)

springBoot.checkDriverDependency.title: Hint when a spring.datasource.url names a JDBC driver the build files do not declare (transitive drivers are not seen)
